caption: The drawing features three distinct objects arranged within a rectangular frame on a light beige background. The central object is a tall, rounded, and narrow-necked ceramic jug with a predominantly pale tan body, shaded with blue-gray tones toward the neck and base. The jug displays a painted dark blue flower with five rounded petals and two simple leaves curving upward from the flower’s base. In the upper left corner of the composition is a small rectangular detail showing a dark blue, stylized branch with several oval leaves on a similarly pale background. In the lower right corner, another small rectangle contains a side profile of a similar jug, depicted with the same color scheme and blue flower decorations, but appearing slimmer and further away. All three elements are outlined with thin black lines, and the composition uses varying intensities of blue, gray, and tan to define shapes and shading.
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
